<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Campaign" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing Campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Campaign">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Marketing" name="Marketing Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_DefineObjectives</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_CreateContent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_DesignVisuals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_SelectChannels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_LaunchCampaign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_TrackPerformance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_AnalyzePerformance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CRM" name="CRM System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_CollectLeads</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sales" name="Sales Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_FollowUpLeads</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_Start" name="Campaign process started"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Activity_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives and target audience"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Activity_CreateContent" name="Create campaign content"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Activity_DesignVisuals" name="Design visuals"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Activity_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Activity_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Activity_TrackPerformance" name="Track campaign performance in real time"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Activity_CollectLeads" name="Collect generated leads in CRM"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Activity_FollowUpLeads" name="Follow up on leads"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Activity_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze campaign performance for future optimization"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_End" name="Campaign period ended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Event_Start" targetRef="Activity_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Activity_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Activity_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Activity_CreateContent" targetRef="Activity_DesignVisuals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Activity_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Activity_SelectChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Activity_SelectChannels" targetRef="Activity_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Activity_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Activity_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Activity_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Activity_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Activity_CollectLeads" targetRef="Activity_FollowUpLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Activity_FollowUpLeads" targetRef="Activity_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Activity_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="Event_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
